code-empty-catch-1.description: IF empty catch block — catch (Exception e) { } - silently swallowing all exceptions

code-generic-catch-2.description: IF catch generic exception AND NOT rethrow — catch (Exception e) { log.error(e); } - hiding failure from caller

code-null-instead-of-exception-3.description: IF throws exception or returns null — Function returns null on failure instead of throwing meaningful exception

code-missing-validation-4.description: IF no validation at api boundary — API endpoint accepts user ID without checking existence or permissions

code-system-exit-misuse-5.description: IF uses system exit for flow control — System.exit(1) used for validation failure in library code

code-ignores-return-value-6.description: IF ignores return value — Call to validation function whose return value is ignored

code-print-statement-8.description: IF uses print instead of logger — System.out.println used for debugging in production code

code-catch-and-continue-9.description: IF catches error and continues — Loop continues after database connection failure

code-logs-secrets-10.description: IF logs sensitive information — Logger.debug(\"Password: \" + password) in authentication flow

code-loose-inequality-2.description: IF `!=` used instead of `!==` — if (user.role != 'admin') - may incorrectly evaluate due to coercion

code-var-usage-3.description: IF `var` used — var i = 0; function scoped incorrectly in loops

code-nested-ternary-9.description: IF nested ternary operators — condition ? val1 : condition2 ? val2 : val3 - hard to read

code-callback-hell-10.description: IF callback hell detected — fs.readFile(..., fs.writeFile(..., fs.chmod(..., ...)))

code-bare-except-1.description: IF `except:` bare — except: pass - catches KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit

code-bare-except-with-others-2.description: IF bare except in try with multiple except — except ValueError: ...; except: ... - bare except overrides specificity

code-mutable-default-3.description: IF mutable default argument — def process(items=[]): items.append('item') - shared across calls

code-mutex-missing-4.description: IF mutex not used — Multiple goroutines accessing shared map without synchronization

code-channel-not-closed-5.description: IF channel not closed — Channel used for worker coordination never closed

code-missing-error-main-10.description: IF missing error handling in main — main() function calls functions that can error but doesn't check
